verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Hosted Payment Page that accepts multiple payment methods with a single integration, and a Drop-in Element that adapts its fields to the payment method and country. It also documents 160+ local payment methods (cited on the invoicing page), local-method enablement via the Multi-Currency Pricing API, and redirect-flow integration guidance, so the core 'many methods, one integration' claim is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit evidence naming Apple Pay, Google Pay and BNPL support; detail on which bank-redirect methods are covered; independent or hands-on corroboration.
